verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents API keys only as personal access tokens that call the same endpoints as the web UI. The evidence shows no per-key scopes, permission restrictions or agent-specific least-privilege credentials. User-level RBAC (roles, groups, permissions) is an adjacent control: a user could approximate scoping with a restricted account, but that is a workaround, not scoped credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
